info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Fiber and Composite Materials

description.describe_ch: 使學生充分了解非織物的定義、分類和特性以及其各種非織物製造技術，含成網和固結等各種方式，亦可學習如何測試非織物製品的各種性質，更進一步了解其應用範圍，以培養具備研究及開發非織物新用途之人才。
description.describe_eh: This course is to acquaint students with the definition, classification, properties, and various manufactures of nonwoven, including web formation and bonding. Students learn how to test different properties of the nonwoven, understand the application field and then become skilled and resourceful R&D engineers for new usages of nonwoven.

description.pre_sub_ename: FCME1047 FIBER  MATERIALS、FCME2012 FABRIC MANUFACURING PROCESS(1)、FCME2040 FABRIC MANUFACTURING PROCESS(2)
